tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in every product. A warm linen white that matches the ground of our AI service images, so images and page read as one surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, table rows, inputs. Sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and grouped-list backgrounds, admin side panels, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: surface-image
tokens.usage: Ground behind every AI service/category image (tiles, banners). Same value in both themes on purpose: our images are opaque with this exact background, so the tile looks like one object in light and dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, selects and secondary buttons (3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, helper text, placeholders, timestamps, table secondary columns. On `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. Never the only carrier of something a person must act on (outdoors it drops below 7:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Namami teal, the logo's own colour, and THE interactive colour: primary buttons, links (always underlined), checkboxes, radios, toggles, progress, selected tabs, active nav, app headers. Light theme uses the exact logo teal; dark lightens it so it stays visible.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of `brand` fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` and `brand-hover` fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active chips, highlighted list items. Text on it is `brand` (light) / `ink` (dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: uniform
tokens.usage: Uniform teal: the dyed colour of Namamian uniforms and of the workers in our service images. FABRIC AND IMAGERY ONLY: never use it for interface controls, links or text (it blurs with `brand` on screen). Final value will be matched to the approved fabric shade card.

tokens.name: on-uniform
tokens.usage: Text on `uniform` fills in print and physical items (badges, lanyard print). Not used in the apps.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Namami gold, the logo's own colour. Offers, savings, ratings, earnings: the one highlight per screen. A fill, never text on light surfaces, never a status.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `gold` fills. On `gold-soft` use `gold-soft-ink`.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet gold background: offer strips, 'Popular' ribbons, savings rows.

tokens.name: gold-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `gold-soft`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element in every product, on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥7:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-brand
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls sitting on a `brand` fill (icon buttons in the teal app header).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (payment received, job completed). On `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success notice/badge background. Text on it: `success-ink`.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `success-soft`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (slot filling up, payment pending). On `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning notice/badge background. Text on it: `warning-ink`.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive buttons, validation messages. On `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error notice/badge background. Text on it: `danger-ink`.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. On `surface`, `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info notice background. Text on it: `info-ink`.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `info-soft`.

tokens.name: status-upcoming-bg
tokens.usage: Status family UPCOMING (backend: received, scheduled, rescheduled): booked, not started. Outlined pill background.

tokens.name: status-upcoming-border
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of the UPCOMING pill (the outline itself is the cue that tells it apart).

tokens.name: status-upcoming-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `status-upcoming-bg`.

tokens.name: status-live-bg
tokens.usage: Status family LIVE (backend: ongoing): a Namamian is working right now. Solid brand-teal pill.

tokens.name: status-live-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `status-live-bg`.

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Status family DONE (backend: completed). Solid green pill.

tokens.name: status-done-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `status-done-bg`.

tokens.name: status-stopped-bg
tokens.usage: Status family STOPPED (backend: cancelled, expired, lapsed): ended without service. Solid slate pill; the word and icon say which.

tokens.name: status-stopped-ink
tokens.usage: Text/icon on `status-stopped-bg`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Spotless homes, right at your door
styles.usage: Website hero headline only, one per page. The only place Poppins 700 is loaded.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Website section heads, customer-app service title. Poppins 600.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles in the customer and captain apps; admin page titles.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen; dialog and sheet titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, service names in lists, admin card headers.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and totals. Always with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and Indian digit grouping (₹1,23,456).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels, set in Mukta 600 (not Poppins). Sentence case.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above values (admin group labels, form sections). Latin only: never uppercase or letter-space Hindi.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Our captain arrives with every tool and product needed, and leaves your home spotless.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: आपकी बुकिंग कन्फ़र्म हो गई है। Your booking is confirmed.
styles.usage: Default text in every product. Minimum size for anything a captain must read in the field.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; key facts (slot time, address line 1).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, helper text, admin table cells. Customer and admin only: in the Namamian app the minimum is `field-small`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, credits, legal footers. 14px is the absolute minimum size for any text in any product.

styles.name: field
styles.usage: Default text in the Namamian (captain) app: used outdoors, in sunlight, often in Hindi.

styles.name: field-strong
styles.usage: Key facts in the Namamian app: slot time, address line, amounts.

styles.name: field-small
styles.usage: Smallest text allowed in the Namamian app.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge inside badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact cards and list rows; gap in tile grids.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on mobile; card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen; admin page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks; website card padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Website section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Admin table chips, keyboard hints. The only sharp-ish corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, checkboxes (6px inside), tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, notices. Map shadcn radius-sm/md/lg explicitly to radius-sm/md/lg: never let shadcn derive off-scale values (it computes 10px from a 12px base).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, image tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), hero cards, modals on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, the floating bottom nav, toggles.

size.note: Control heights. Customer app and website: at least `control-md`. Namamian app: `control-xl` for every action.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense admin tables and toolbars only (mouse users).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, list rows. Minimum touch target in the customer and captain apps.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action at the bottom of a mobile screen (Book now, Start job, Pay).

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Every action in the Namamian (captain) app, with at least 12px between targets: tapped with gloves on.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small text, badges, table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size next to body text and in buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation icons (bottom nav, app header).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width on the website and admin pages.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of long text (policies, blog).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `surface`, image tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised/hover cards, dropdowns, the floating bottom nav.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, toasts.
